name: building-wordpress-blog
description: Two skills for launching WordPress sites: building-site-identity interviews you about the person or organization behind a site (people in recovery, advocates, clinicians, nonprofits) and writes a sourced, approved identity profile as Markdown plus a Google Doc for AI writers; building-wordpress-blog adds an SEO-first, i18n-ready blog (46-question intake, one-page plan, 18-section spec, pass/fail checklist, the Blog Kit site plugin and AI hero images via Gemini).
